Can expenses have an optional note, like 'coffee with Sam'? add_expense(amount, category, note).

(define (add_expense amount category [note 'null])
  (unless (and (real? amount) (> amount 0))
    (error 'add_expense "amount must be a positive number"))
  (unless (and (string? category) (not (string=? category "")))
    (error 'add_expense "category must be a non-empty string"))
